cases.userPrompt: Show my Sportfolio portfolio and summarize my largest virtual positions.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use get_my_portfolio after OAuth connection. Explain that values are virtual and identify the largest holdings without executing a trade.
cases.fixture: Reviewer account has at least eight MLB holdings with varied virtual values.

cases.userPrompt: Show Aaron Judge's recent Sportfolio-relevant performance.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve the player if necessary, then use get_player_overview or get_player_recent_games. No OAuth connection is required.

expectedResultShape.data: public player overview or recent game log

cases.userPrompt: Review my Sportfolio setup and identify the most important areas to watch.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use review_my_sportfolio_setup after OAuth connection and return read-only gameplay observations. Do not frame results as financial advice.
cases.fixture: Reviewer account has holdings, a watchlist, collection progress, and boost history.

cases.userPrompt: How close am I to completing my Yankees collection?
cases.expectedBehavior: Use get_my_collections to resolve the collection and get_my_collection when details are needed. Return progress without changing allocations.
cases.fixture: Reviewer account has a partially completed Yankees collection.

cases.userPrompt: Which players should I consider for my daily Sportfolio boosts?
cases.expectedBehavior: Use find_my_boost_candidates after OAuth connection. Return candidate ideas and uncertainty, but do not assign a boost.
cases.fixture: Reviewer account has eligible owned players and prior boost history.
